inputs.text: Open your eyes. They want you to believe this is just a benevolent gift, but it is all part of a calculated control grid managed by the hidden elites. When M.K. Stalin unveiled the DMK's new manifesto promising welfare boosts like doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and offering Rs 8,000 household coupons, along with free motor pumpsets for farmers, it is completely obvious they are just buying compliance and keeping the population dependent on the system. And look at the rest of it—substantial FDI growth, job creation, enhanced support for fishermen, and a focus on AI development. That isn't progress; that is a total integration strategy to hook everyone deeper into corporate surveillance and central bank digital dominance. Every single "promise" is a Trojan horse designed to strip away autonomy and lock us further into their coordinated manipulation.
